note: Editor interface buttons -- operator-defined fixed vocabulary for editing actions (e.g., Cut, Copy, Paste, Undo, Redo, Find, Replace, Close, Save)
Editor interface toggle buttons -- operator-defined fixed vocabulary for view modes (e.g., Word Wrap, Show Line Numbers, Sidebar visibility)
Editor interface radio buttons -- operator-defined fixed vocabulary for layout or mode selection (e.g., 'Single', 'Dual', 'Horizontal', 'Vertical')
Editor interface checkboxes -- operator-defined fixed vocabulary for feature toggles (e.g., 'Auto Indent', 'Highlight Current Line', 'Show Spaces')
Table column headers -- operator-defined fixed vocabulary for data columns (e.g., 'Name', 'Size', 'Type', 'Modified')
